service.description: Pooled storage replication between cluster members on the Core network: the LumenFS peer link on TCP 7800 to 7809, one port per pool. Bind this service to Core interfaces only — replication never rides Management or an External network. The pool daemon's control surface is deliberately not here: it listens on the loopback address, because it is the local orchestration seam rather than a cluster protocol, and a fence verdict arriving from off-box is not something this appliance accepts.
